title: Victor + Haze: Bullet Resist Shredder on Victor, Spirit Shredder/Rend on Haze
question: Does Victor's aura keep Bullet Resist Shredder on the whole clump for Haze, and does Haze's Spirit Shredder/Rend raise Victor's aura damage?
hypothesis: H-B2-1.1: Haze gun damage on 3 bots inside Victor's aura (Victor with BRS) is >=8% higher than with base Victor (no BRS). H-B2-1.2: Victor aura damage on Haze's target is >=6% higher with Spirit Shredder, >=25% with Spirit Rend at 4 stacks. H-B2-1.3: Ricochet splits apply Spirit Shredder to secondary bots (debuff icon on >=2 bots). H-B2-1.4: Victor heals from Spirit Shredder's 10% ally spirit lifesteal (Victor healing per 10s rises by >=8% of his aura damage on that bot).

setup.position: Victor in the middle of 3 bots (within 6m), Haze 8m behind him

controls: Cooldowns, HP and debuffs reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Victor channels Aura of Suffering for 8s
Haze shoots bot 1 for the same 8s (aim at the head for the Rend arm)
Read per-hero damage on each bot (damage numbers / health delta) and the debuff icons
Repeat with Haze firing first and Victor joining 1s later

metrics.name: haze_gun_damage_dealt_8s
metrics.how: Haze damage summed over the 3 bots

decision.rule: SUPPORTS if duo_pair beats base_pair by >=8% with non-overlapping ranges; REFUTES if <3%; else INCONCLUSIVE. Victor side judged separately on victor_aura_damage_dealt_bot1_8s (>=6% Shredder, >=25% Rend).
